tickets.text: Poor service
Looked like a cool place but the hours on Google are incorrect so I showed up at about 8pm and then were closed when maps said they were open until midnight.

Horrible experience. We had some friends in from out of town who wanted to get some souvenirs before returning home. We decided to try this place out since it had good reviews. We walked into an empty shop and were immediately confronted by the cashier asking if we had masks. When we stated we didn't (since most places no longer require them) she refused to even let us enter and told us to go buy masks before we came back. I'm sorry,  but if you are still planning to require masks, you should either offer them customers complementary or sell them in your shop. We ended up finding another cool shop next door that allowed us to enter and shop without masks. My friends spent over $100 on souvenirs at the other shop. We have friends in from out of town all the time and I am always looking for cool places to take them. I can confidently say that this shop will never receive my service again while the shop next door has gained a couple new loyal customers. Talk about a bad experience.

A tiny gift shop for the museum of the weird, which you need tickets to see. Most everything for sale is generic trinkets on the odd style and not unique to the area. Kind of disappointing but clerk was very polite and friendly

The food is okay, not great. Atmosphere is small, but cute.  Lots of unhoused people outside, which didn't make us feel the most safe as they were a little aggressive in trying to get money from people and trying to get the attention of drivers passing by.
Both dishes we had were very peppery tasting, but not overwhelming.  The biggest issue we had was as our server was mixing the oil by shaking it, he didn't make sure the top was completely on.  The oil got on the table, my arm, and more importantly, my shirt.  I hoped it would come out in the wash, but it did not.  He did apologize, but maybe offering a free drink or dessert would've made the situation better.  I'm sure he's a great server as we had no other issues during our visit, but it would've gone a long way offering some small comp, especially since my shirt is ruined.

I had the fettuccine Alfredo. It was ok. I would hazard a guess that it contained cream and flour. Incorrect. Three ingredients: butter, Parmesan cheese, and some pasta water. Same as carbonara: no creme. Some reviews praised it for not being heavy. Maybe make a traditional and less heavy. It's SUPPOSED to be enough calories to feed a family of 6. The pasta is house made an' all. Why would you go to that effort, but then cover it in biscuit gravy? I dunno. It was ok.

We went for the first time.The manager Annalisa noticed that our food order was taking too long.
She let us know, made sure things moved fast, and gave a freebie on the beers.

The drinks took a while so we were only able to order two small cocktails in a hour. If it’s your first time, you’re better off spending your money elsewhere, the bartenders connected better with people they knew already and didn’t say thank you or bye like they did with others. We spent $90 for 4 cocktails and mixed nuts. We left looking for a spot to end the night on a better note and found Higbies.
